name: Rarotonga
tagline: Laid-back lagoon island of the Cook Islands
summary: Rarotonga is the friendly main island of the Cook Islands, ringed by a turquoise lagoon and volcanic peaks. Kayak Muri Lagoon, snorkel the Aroa reserve, hike the Cross-Island Track, browse the Saturday market and fly to Aitutaki's legendary lagoon.
seasonNote: May to October is dry and pleasant; November to April is hot and humid with cyclone risk.
arrival: Rarotonga International is 10 minutes from Avarua.
gettingAround: One round-island road with clockwise and anticlockwise buses; scooters and bikes.
cashTip: The New Zealand dollar is used (plus local coins); cards work at resorts and shops, but carry cash for markets and buses.
foodTip: Ika mata, market food and island nights.
buyTip: Black pearls, tivaevae quilts and pareus.
